definitions.gloss: sociability; friendliness; ability to get along with others
definitions.explanation: The personality trait of enjoying and being skilled at interacting with other people. Frequently discussed as a desirable quality in job applicants, children, and well-adjusted adults.

examples.japanese: {社交性|しゃこうせい}がある。
{彼|かれ}は{社交性|しゃこうせい}に{欠|か}ける。
{子供|こども}のうちに{社交性|しゃこうせい}を{身|み}につけることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to develop sociability during childhood.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}の{仕事|しごと}には{高|たか}い{社交性|しゃこうせい}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Sales jobs require a high level of sociability.

notes:
Compound of {社交|しゃこう} ('socializing; social interaction') and the suffix {性|せい} ('-ness; -ity; nature'). The {性|せい} suffix attaches to many nouns to form abstract trait words: {可能性|かのうせい} ('possibility'), {重要性|じゅうようせい} ('importance'), {個性|こせい} ('individuality').

USAGE:
Most often appears in descriptions of personality and in job-related discussions of desirable traits. Phrased as {社交性|しゃこうせい}がある/ない ('to have/lack sociability') or {社交性|しゃこうせい}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い ('to have high/low sociability').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}がある: to be sociable
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}に{欠|か}ける: to lack sociability
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}が{高|たか}い: highly sociable
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}を{身|み}につける: to develop sociability
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}を{養|やしな}う: to cultivate sociability
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}が{求|もと}められる: sociability is required

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {社交的|しゃこうてき}: sociable (adjective form) — {彼|かれ}は{社交的|しゃこうてき}だ ('He is sociable')
- {協調性|きょうちょうせい}: cooperativeness — working well in a group rather than socializing per se
- {人当|ひとあ}たり: manner toward others; how one comes across — more about first impression
- {愛想|あいそ}: amiability; sociability — often in {愛想|あいそ}がいい ('affable, friendly')
- {内向的|ないこうてき}: introverted — opposite trait
